scripts.docs:test: npm run docs:build && node out/docs-examples/authoring-build.js && node out/docs-examples/runtime-extension.js
scripts.build: npm run contracts:check && npm run build --workspace @prismatix/authoring-sdk && npm run runtime:build && npm run cli:build && npm run docs:build
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspace @prismatix/authoring-sdk && npm run runtime:test && npm run cli:test && npm run test:package && npm run docs:test
